title: Functions to Analyze Mid-Infrared Spectra of Peat Samples
text: ‘irpeat’ R package contains functions analyze infrared spectra peat samples. functions functions compute humification indices functions predict peat properties. functions may also work organic matter samples general. following peat properties can predicted (note model-specific limitations described documentation): Elemental contents (C, H, N, O, S, P, K, Ti) isotope values (δ13C δ15N) physical properties (bulk density, volume fraction solids, non-macroporosity, macroporosity, saturated hydraulic conductivity, specific heat capacity, dry thermal conductivity) standard Gibbs free energy formation (ΔGf0) electrochemical properties (electron accepting capacity, electron donating capacity) microbial nitrogen content (modified version model described Reuter et al. (2020)) degree decomposition (γ\gamma, fraction initial mass lost (Teickner et al. 2026; Teickner 2025b)). package also contains functions predict holocellulose Klason lignin contents (Hodgkins et al. 2018; Teickner Knorr 2022), models biased peat samples (Teickner Knorr 2022).
